title: Patching Array
description: Determine the minimum number of patches required to make all numbers in [1, n] reachable as sums of a subset.
pseudocode:
1. reach = 1, patches = 0, i = 0
2. while reach <= n:
3.   if i < nums.length and nums[i] <= reach:
4.     reach += nums[i], i++
5.   else:
6.     reach += reach, patches++

steps.note: Initialize variables: reach is the smallest sum we cannot yet form.
Check if reach (1) <= n (6). Condition true.
Update reach to 2, move index i to 1.
Check if reach (2) <= n (6). Condition true.
Patch needed: Add reach (2) to array. New reach = 4.
Check if reach (4) <= n (6). Condition true.
Patch needed: Add reach (4) to array. New reach = 8.
Check if reach (8) <= n (6). Condition false. Terminate.
